01 / The yard

A family yard since 2003.

Craneworx is the Lockwoods. When you ring, you talk to the people who own the cranes and drive them.

  1. Started2003

    Joe Lockwood starts Craneworx with one Franna.

  2. Joined2008

    His son Daniel joins the family business.

  3. Today24/7

    Crane hire, rigging and transport from the Wingfield yard, any hour, any day.

02 / Services

From lift to delivery.

One call covers the crane, the rigging and the truck, so the load is handled by one crew from pick-up to set-down.

05 / How it works

Before you call.

Three things that make the first call quick. If you don’t know them yet, ring anyway.

  1. 01

    Describe the load.

    What needs moving? Have the dimensions and weight handy if you know them.

  2. 02

    Talk through access.

    Share the address, how the crew can enter and where the load needs to finish.

  3. 03

    Discuss timing.

    Call Joe or Daniel with your preferred date to discuss the job and availability.
